name: Ka'imi Fairbairn

background.fact: Born January 29, 1994 in Kailua, Hawaii, to John and Rochelle Fairbairn. His full name is John Christian Ka'iminoeauloameka'ikeokekumupa'a Fairbairn, and he has gone by Ka'imi since childhood; the name means 'seeker of wisdom'.

At Punahou School in Honolulu he was a two-sport star in football and soccer (two-time first-team all-state central defender, two state titles), and he was ranked the No. 4 kicking recruit in the country.

At UCLA he won the kicking job as a true freshman in 2012, became the Pac-12 career scoring record holder, kicked a 60-yard field goal in 2015, was a consensus first-team All-American and won the Lou Groza Award as the top college kicker in 2015.

background.fact: He signed with Houston as an undrafted free agent in 2016 and was named the starting kicker in 2017. His career field goal percentage is 87.9 percent, listed as fourth best in NFL history.

Contract data in the file shows a 2020 deal for 4 years and $17.65 million, but the file says later extensions are missing; one lifestyle article mentions a $15.9 million contract, so the contract is not confirmed.
